headline: 請假已讀不回！全國停擺
ticker: 主管拇指離奇失聯｜請假申請卡住國運｜點個頭竟引發紙崩
anchor_script: 震撼！員工只是請一天假，主管竟然已讀不回！訊息送達，假期卻原地失蹤！當事人守著手機，從早等到盆栽都彎腰！辦公室緊急拉起封鎖線，搜救主管失聯的回覆能力！更驚人的是，主管終於點頭，整櫃文件當場雪崩！這是假單，還是國運開關？本台虛構追蹤，提醒您：別讓員工等到長香菇！
cast: The employee is a 28-year-old woman with a short black bob, a yellow cardigan, white shirt, and navy trousers; the supervisor is a 45-year-old man with neatly parted black hair, a gray suit, and a green tie.

shots.scene_en: In an office, the employee anxiously taps a phone displaying only two plain colored circles while the supervisor sits at a distant desk, filmed over her shoulder with no text, letters, or logos anywhere.

In the same office, the supervisor glances at his phone and freezes with his thumb hovering dramatically above its blank screen, filmed in an extreme low-angle close-up with no text, letters, or logos anywhere.
At her office desk, the employee slumps beside an absurdly drooping potted plant while staring at her blank phone, filmed in a wide symmetrical shot with no text, letters, or logos anywhere.

In the office, the employee surrounds the motionless supervisor with plain orange inflatable barriers and searches around his hovering thumb using a magnifying glass, filmed from overhead with no text, letters, or logos anywhere.

In the office, the supervisor finally nods as a cabinet erupts into an avalanche of blank paper and the employee triumphantly raises both arms beneath the fluttering sheets, filmed in a dramatic wide low-angle shot with no text, letters, or logos anywhere.
